turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a, an and the?
turns.tutor:
Example: I see ___ hat.
"hat" starts with a "h" sound. Not a vowel sound, so I write: I see a hat.
Rule: use "an" before a vowel sound (a, e, i, o, u), and "a" before other sounds.
This is right: I see an ant. This is wrong: I see a ant.
Now you try. Write a or an:
She has ___ orange in her bag. (answer with only the missing word)
